verdict.rationale: Fern's docs say it automatically generates and maintains an llms.txt file for every docs site, and a live probe got HTTP 200 for llms.txt on Fern's own published site. Per-page clean Markdown via .md suffixes is also documented, but that is not a single full-content variant. missing for 10: documented llms-full.txt or equivalent full-content variant, independent corroboration beyond Fern's own site.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my published docs site automatically serves llms.txt (and a full-content variant) so agents can index it

citations.quote: Fern implements this standard, automatically generating and maintaining an `llms.txt` Markdown file so AI tools can discover and index your documentation.
PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://buildwithfern.com/llms.txt # Fern Documentation
Fern serves clean Markdown for any documentation page so agents can consume your content efficiently.
